title: Los años de Menem
goal: Read about the political side of Menem's Argentina -- the 1993 Pacto de Olivos, the 1994 constitutional reform enabling his 1995 reelection, corruption scandals, and the personal style that gave "menemismo" its name.

items: State what the 1993 Pacto de Olivos did.
Explain how Menem used the 1994 reform in 1995.
Name two corruption scandals of his government.
Use valerse de to describe using something to one's advantage.
I can state what the 1993 Pacto de Olivos did.
I can explain how Menem used the 1994 reform in 1995.
I can name two corruption scandals of his government.
I can describe what "menemismo" refers to.
I can use valerse de to describe using something to one's advantage.
